name: duck-list-header
title: Duck List Header
description: Column labels over a stack of DuckListRows, with a sort control and a column contract the header and the rows actually share. DuckList writes the track list once as --duck-list-cols, so a column width is declared in one place instead of copied onto every row. Plain divs, no table roles: the sort direction is announced in words. Row selection or resizable columns want a real <table> instead.
